# Meeting Briefing: Perplexity AI
**Date/Time:** November 20, 2026 @ 10:00 AM IST

## Recent developments
* **Open-Weights Model Release:** Perplexity released open weights for *pplx-decider-v1.3* and *pplx-decider-flash-v1.3* on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license, providing specialized text-span extraction and routing classifiers built on Qwen architectures [1].
* **Teammates Expansion:** The company expanded its proactive agentic AI feature, *Teammates*, to the Mac app for Max subscribers (previously limited to iOS and the web) to handle collaborative tasks like QA, research, and customer service [4].
* **Financial & Enterprise Growth:** Perplexity’s AI answer engine/agent platform crossed a US$750 million annualized run-rate, driven heavily by enterprise adoption (such as PayPal running 74,000 queries a week) and integration into Samsung's Galaxy S26 Galaxy AI [2].
* **Legal Challenge:** Perplexity AI faces a class action lawsuit filed in a California federal court concerning undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features [3].

## Talking points
* **Enterprise & Agent Orchestration:** Discuss the scaling of Perplexity's "Computer" agent platform and multi-model orchestration, noting enterprise wins like PayPal and device-level deployments like Samsung Galaxy AI [2].
* **Developer Ecosystem:** Address the strategic rationale behind releasing the *pplx-decider-v1.3* open-weights models under Apache 2.0 and how they fit into broader automated research workflows [1].
* **Product Expansion:** Review the cross-platform rollout of *Teammates* for Max subscribers on Mac and iOS, and evaluate future enterprise productivity use cases [4].

## Open questions
* How will Perplexity address the recent consumer class-action lawsuit regarding paid subscription usage limits to retain subscriber trust [3]?
* What are the deployment roadmap and monetization goals for the newly released *pplx-decider-v1.3* and *Flash* open-weight models within enterprise environments [1]?
* How does the expansion of agentic features like *Teammates* on desktop and mobile impact infrastructure scaling relative to their Microsoft Azure and AWS partnerships [2, 4]?

## Sources
* [1] CASRAI — Perplexity Decider v1.3 & Flash Open Weights (https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026)
* [2] AI Magazine — Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate (https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate)
* [3] Top Class Actions — Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features (https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features)
* [4] 9to5Mac — Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac (https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brings-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac)
